error[L0103]: `public` cannot modify a fixed conditional
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/r491-public-fixed/main.ldn:1:1
  |
1 | public fixed if true then
  | ^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/r491-public-fixed/main.ldn:1:8
  |
1 | public fixed if true then
  |        ^^^^^ the fixed conditional starts here
  = note: D139: a fixed conditional selects module declarations; it is not a declaration with an export modifier
